source: ModelOff 2013 Round 2, 'Acquisition Financing'; terms and answers as transcribed in generic_engine/tests/test_benchmark_round2_acquisition_financing.py

inputs.basis: quarterly, 30/360: each quarter's interest is the opening balance x rate / 4

tranche_1.repayment: equal payments of interest and principal (PMT)

tranche_2.repayment: level principal of the amount over the amortising quarters

tranche_3.repayment: interest only, bullet at maturity; a draw at a quarter end earns interest from the next quarter

tranche_4.repayment: interest capitalised for two years, then interest paid and 16 equal principal payments of the capitalised balance
